analysis_run_current_shape.name: analysis_run_current_shape
analysis_run_current_shape.value: ("analysis_run"."purpose" = 'current') = ("analysis_run"."profile_version_id" is not null and "analysis_run"."profile_change_id" is null)

analysis_run_preview_shape.name: analysis_run_preview_shape
analysis_run_preview_shape.value: ("analysis_run"."purpose" = 'preview') = ("analysis_run"."profile_change_id" is not null and "analysis_run"."profile_version_id" is null)

dataset_version_date_or_note.name: dataset_version_date_or_note
dataset_version_date_or_note.value: "dataset_version"."source_as_of" is not null or "dataset_version"."source_as_of_note" is not null

dataset_version_ready_shape.name: dataset_version_ready_shape
dataset_version_ready_shape.value: "dataset_version"."status" <> 'ready' or ("dataset_version"."confidence" is not null and "dataset_version"."confidence_rationale" is not null and "dataset_version"."feature_count" is not null)

records_export_ready_shape.name: records_export_ready_shape
records_export_ready_shape.value: ("records_export"."status" = 'ready') = ("records_export"."object_key" is not null and "records_export"."sha256" is not null)

retention_flag_review_shape.name: retention_flag_review_shape
retention_flag_review_shape.value: ("retention_flag"."outcome" is null) = ("retention_flag"."reviewed_at" is null and "retention_flag"."reviewed_by" is null)

report_released_shape.name: report_released_shape
report_released_shape.value: ("report"."status" = 'released') = ("report"."pdf_sha256" is not null and "report"."released_at" is not null)
